Participants were asked to annotate 14 potential task instances as well as 2 additional screening questions. The screening questions were randomly sampled from a list of 10 screening questions. We filtered out all crowdworkers that wrongly answered any of the screening questions.

changes_made.explanation: Restructured guidelines to be more informative and removed redundant information. Added explicit criteria for style similarity ordering.

overall_notes: The paper introduces STEL framework for evaluating style similarity methods. It focuses on evaluating style measuring capabilities rather than generating text. The human evaluation was used to validate the task instances, not to evaluate NLG outputs directly. The automatic metrics are used to evaluate style similarity methods, not traditional NLG outputs. Paper is more about evaluation methodology than NLG generation.
